senses.gloss: an unlawful space between a deed and the signatures of the witnesses.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:4:3">Y. Gitt. I, 43ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>עדים פסולין אינן נעשין כה׳ ע׳</he> the signatures of disqualified witnesses, between qualified ones, are not to be looked upon as if they were a blank creating an unlawful distance; ib. IX, 50ᶜ; ib. VIII, end, 49ᵈ (insert: <he>עדים פסולים אינן</he>).—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: distance of relationship, i.e. testimony not objectionable on account of kinship.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:7:4">Y. Keth. II, 26ᵈ</cite> top [read:] <he>ואם אין את מאמינו שהוא בנו יעשה כה׳ ע׳ וכ׳</he> and if you do not believe him that he is his son, let his statement (that he is a priest) be considered a stranger’s testimony &c.
senses.label: b
